According to the method specified in the problem, use the DS-BPSK main-lobe bandwidth formula B_s = 2R_c. Given R_c = 16R_b, so B_s = 2 × 16R_b = 32R_b. In the problem, according to the method draft, the main-lobe bandwidth of d(t) is taken as R_b, therefore B_s / B_d = 32R_b / R_b = 32.
